name: com.fair.pixelart-splats
description: Gaussian surfels drawn as pixel art in URP. Surfaces become flat shaded discs, lit once at bake time or per frame, then voted into a small palette at a fixed pixel grid, with ink outlines, translucent light and optional ordered dithering. Includes the scene authoring tools (signed distance shapes, a surface sampler, baked lighting) and a mesh-to-splat baker.

samples.description: A caravan camp at an oasis drawn as pixel art splats: a striped tent, a cooking fire with its glow, palms and a pond. 147 769 surfels, 16 colours. Open the scene and press Play.
